objections.reason: 'existence véritable' is the established rendering used in T677; 'existence vraie' is inconsistent.
Participle 'exauçant' is clumsy and differs from the children field and from T371; use the same relative clause.
Same garuḍa as T530, rendered 'oiseau géant du ciel'; keep identical.

objections.sense: obscuration of afflictions and of objects of knowledge
objections.proposed: obscurcissement des afflictions et du connaissable
objections.reason: āvaraṇa/sgrib pa is 'obscurcissement' in T598 academic; 'voile' is the children's rendering.
'celui qui éprouve' is already T294 (vedaka, feeler); bhoktṛ (experiencer) needs a distinct rendering.
'celui qui ressent' is already T294 (vedaka); keep bhoktṛ distinct.
Academic field says 'pouvoir'; children's 'force' is used for bala/dpung (T515) and inconsistent with 'pouvoir' for stobs (T521).
Same sthūla is 'grossier' in T190 children; 'gros' means big or fat and changes the meaning.
'grand monde' means high society in French and is vague; 'univers' conveys lokadhātu simply.

objections.proposed: communauté des moines et des moniales
objections.reason: Align with T302 'moniale'; 'nonnes' is a Christian term.
English and T729 use 'Saṅgha'; 'Saṃgha' is an inconsistent transliteration of the same word.
